text:
mike: Heads-up, 45m workshop tomorrow to finalize long-horizon routing + multi-tenant isolation roadmap. Goal: concrete specs, launch criteria, prioritized customer asks (Acme / FinApps / Healthcare). Bring 1 slide + deps.
maya: +1. Include Dedicated/Private rollout constraints — data residency + latency SLAs are popping up.
vikram: Add model-aware routing: kernel/quant compat matrix, fallback order, and KV cache migration cost per tenant.
nana: Observability = acceptance criteria. Need token-level traces, per-route p95, and model-variant cost attribution + trace-id propagation.
sara: Draft gates: cross-region fallback <200ms p95, canary for 1% tenant-slice with auto-fallback, console shows token cost by model/route, migration docs + rollback playbook.
kim: Priorities: 1) isolation lanes (regulated) 2) low-latency affinity 3) cost-optimized shared lanes. Map to Dedicated/Private availability.
mike: Action: drop 3 bullets here (customer ask, hard dep, gate). I'll synth into a strawman.
vikram: Canary sketch:
```
policy:
  fallback_order: [regional-variant, quantized-variant, cpu-fallback]
  canary:
    type: tenant-slice
    percent: 1
    duration_hours: 72
    rollback_signal: quality_regression > 0.5%
```
nana: Telemetry hooks required at router+runtime: route_id, model_variant, token_count, token_cost, trace_id.
sara: Ops: automated rollback for quantized models if eval set quality drops; need escalation playbook and synthetic prompt set.
mike: Workshop agenda: 1) customer asks + deps (15m) 2) draft spec & canary (15m) 3) acceptance gates & telemetry (10m) 4) timeline & owners (5m). Bring slides. :thumbsup:
